description_en: Update the text-to-speech (TTS) configuration for an existing canvas scenario
description_zh: 修改旧画布场景的tts配置
kebab_example: aliyun outboundbot modify-tts-config --instance-id 27244bae-e446-4811-bb1d-f8a07b525af0 --script-id 1f1a2ba0-b3e7-4ff9-baf1-6dc8aeac0791 --voice aixia --speech-rate 0 --volume 100 --nls-service-type Managed --app-key 990000Aw --pitch-rate 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTTSConfig

parameters.description_en: Voice model, such as aixia, siyue, or xiaoyun
parameters.description_zh: 发音人信息，如：aixia / siyue / xiaoyun
parameters.help_en: Voice model, such as aixia, siyue, or xiaoyun
parameters.help_zh: 发音人信息，如：aixia / siyue / xiaoyun
parameters.name: voice

parameters.description_en:
Speech rate. An integer between -500 and 500. Default is 0.

A value greater than 0 increases speech speed.

A value less than 0 decreases speech speed.
parameters.description_zh:
语速
[-500,500]之间整数。默认值为0。

大于0表示加快语速。

小于0表示减慢语速。

parameters.description_en:
The service type.
Managed: The default public Intelligent Speech Interaction service for Outbound Bot.
Authorized: A private Intelligent Speech Interaction service that you have purchased. To grant authorization, navigate to Scenario Management > Edit > Call Service > Custom Service.
parameters.description_zh:
服务类型
Managed：智能外呼产品默认智能语音交互产品服务（公共服务）。
Authorized：公有云客户自己购买的智能语音交互产品服务（客户私有服务），通过场景管理-编辑-调用服务-自定义服务完成授权。
